indra-ocr-1-1-release.title: Indra OCR1.1 release and evaluation
indra-ocr-1-1-release.measurement_operator: Datalab; author card says default auto and math accuracy use benchmark adapter/scorer; OCR-only is authors own run
indra-ocr-1-1-release.note: Not OmniDocBench and not olmOCR-bench; new secondary protocol necessary. Auto reads digitalPDF text layer and OCRs missing content; cannot silently combine with image-only scores. Pin1.1 generation: older authorcard/crawler scores62.1/66.8 are obsolete and different from current66.7/71.4. Current card offers only selected olmOCR-bench splits under own harness200dpi, no complete compatible overall; do not synthesize one. PP-StructureV3 comparator excludes19 stalled pages; avoid presenting that comparator as identical full2937page coverage.

logics-parsing-v3-release.title: Logics-Parsing-V3 release and evaluation
logics-parsing-v3-release.note: Scores transcribed from author table images and visually inspected, not inferred from chart bars. OmniDocBench v1.6 is single-page; separate from MPDocBench multi-page context. MPDocBench evaluation420documents/3135pages; reported efficiency usesH100,batch1,window3; default runtime window2, singlepagewindow1. Edit-distance metrics lower better; CDM/TEDS/F1/overall higher better. MPDocBench-Long is constructed concatenated corpus and must remain separate from MPDocBench-Parse.
